format: Kiosk drive-thru Store (650 to 700 sq ft freestanding kiosk on leased site), not including the purchase of land

invest.quote: Total (See note 11) $1,163,650 to $1,345,750 (Kiosk). Cover: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a SCOOTER’S COFFEE franchise is from $658,898 to $1,345,750. This includes $220,000 to $286,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: The “Initial Franchise Fee” for an individual SCOOTER’S COFFEE Store is $40,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is due and payable in a lump sum by an Automated Clearing House network transfer (“ACH”) when you sign the Franchise Agreement and is not refundable.
fee.note: Plus a mandatory Initial Opening Support Fee of $20,000 paid to the franchisor at signing. Honorably discharged veterans receive a $20,000 product credit from the affiliate Scooter's Coffee Supply Chain (first Store only). MSD Agreement: $20,000 development fee per additional Store, credited against its fee. In 2025 the predecessor received initial franchise fees ranging from $20,000 to $40,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty 6% of Net Sales Paid by electronic funds transfer every Tuesday for the preceding Reporting Period.

adFund.quote: National Marketing and Advertising Contribution Currently 2% of Net Sales, although we may require you to pay up to 4% of Net Sales
adFund.note: Currently 2%, up to 4%. Local marketing: none currently, may require up to 2% of Net Sales. Regional co-ops: none currently, up to 3%. Maximum total marketing and advertising expense 5% of Net Sales.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently $350 per month. This fee is subject to an annual increase of 15%.

otherRecurring.name: Inventory Management Program
otherRecurring.amount: None currently, although we may require you to spend up to .25% of Net Sales

otherRecurring.name: Inventory purchases from affiliate Scooter's Coffee Supply Chain

transferFee.amount: The greater of $10,000 or 25% of the then-current initial franchise fee for a new Store if you transfer your Franchise Agreement.

item19.note: Gross Sales = Net Sales plus Discounts. Excludes non-traditional and Coffeehouse Stores, affiliate-owned Stores, Stores that permanently closed (22 Kiosks in 2025) and Stores not reporting. EBITDA uses reported COGS, labor (excluding employee benefits and overhead staff) and rent, plus estimated card processing (2.6% of Gross Sales) and estimated overhead ($52,500 in the table), imputed royalty/marketing/technology fees; before debt service, depreciation and amortization and owner compensation is not stated as deducted.

special: A $20,000 Initial Opening Support Fee is due on top of the franchise fee. Initial inventory and most store equipment must be bought from the affiliate Scooter's Coffee Supply Chain ($160,000 to $226,000 for a Kiosk), and ongoing inventory purchases are from that affiliate. Technology Fee rises 15% per year, compounded. Kiosk Item 7 excludes land; franchisees who bought real estate paid $250,000 to $1,300,000.
issues: Cover range ($658,898 to $1,345,750) mixes End Cap low and Kiosk high; Kiosk-only Item 7 total is $1,163,650 to $1,345,750 (End Cap $658,898 to $1,068,525). Kiosk 2025 average gross sales is $999,869 in Section A but 998,869 in the Section C table. Overhead note says average $49,800 but tables use 52,500. Item 19 counts 881 franchised / 25 affiliate vs Item 20 882 / 24 (one officer-owned Kiosk counted as affiliate in Item 19). Section C says 697 Kiosks operated all of 2025 while Section A counts 761 Participating Kiosks.
